author: EveryField
scope: Operational patterns in one exact organization authorized portfolio; launch progress and coordination, not church health, pastoral/people qualification or census-wide benchmarks.

eligibility.subject: Exact constrained organization ID+kind from current trusted context.
eligibility.plant: Current authorized exact-org affiliation/grant, shared_findings ON, currently released result, and every underlying category permission for the particular contribution.
eligibility.dedupe_key: canonical PlantId per rule/key/group; repeated affiliations/versions/evidence do not multiply support
eligibility.health_off: Independently allowed identity/link may show Not shared; no state/reason/input/contribution/denominator credit.
eligibility.missing_input: Unknown; absent values excluded from substantive observed denominator; not negative/healthy/zero.
eligibility.zero: Real observed zero retained as an observed value but does not satisfy a positive-gap selector.

grouping.minimum_applied: independently for every rule/key at every level
grouping.whole_portfolio: all currently eligible plants in exact organization, including unresolved geography; independently deduplicated
grouping.region: one actual primary US metro/micro CBSA association, pinned release/code/type; multistate region intact
grouping.state_province: actual country-qualified state/province, independent of CBSA
grouping.country: actual country, no guessed US default
grouping.missing_region: eligible larger known levels/whole remain available

rules.name: Recurring shared concern
rules.input: Released organization-facing structured PI concern with stable concern_key and lens_key; all source-category grants passed.
rules.selector: For a fixed concern_key, count distinct eligible plants with that actual released concern. At least two support a pattern; no diagnosis is invented from a label.
rules.next_step: Offer an organization support conversation about this recorded launch-progress concern; leave cause and pastoral judgment to humans.
rules.template: {support_count} plants share this recorded {concern_key} concern among {observed_lens_count} plants with available shared evidence for this lens.

rules.name: Recurring shared strength
rules.input: Released organization-facing structured strength with stable lens_key and strength_key; current eligible evidence.
rules.selector: At least two distinct eligible plants have the same actual shared strength_key. Unknown/not_shared never count as a strength.
rules.next_step: Offer a voluntary exchange of recorded operational practice through authorized plant links; do not infer transferability, qualifications or guaranteed outcomes.
rules.template: {support_count} plants have a shared {strength_key} strength in the available evidence. A conversation may help the organization learn what they found useful.

rules.name: Near-launch preparation support
rules.input: Actual uncompleted launch status/date plus deterministically unresolved assignment or required-training gap, with full underlying category provenance.
rules.selector: For each eligible plant, 0 <= plant-local days_to_launch <= 30 AND (known unfilled required responsibility count > 0 OR known outstanding applicable required training obligations > 0). At least two qualifying distinct plants support the pattern. Near date alone does not qualify; missing gap/date is Unknown.
rules.next_step: Coordinate a bounded preparation support conversation with the affected authorized plants. Do not move dates, change phase, fill roles or claim launch failure.
rules.template: {support_count} plants within 30 calendar days of an uncompleted launch have a recorded assignment or required-training gap.

rules.name: Follow-up ownership support
rules.input: Shared aggregates of actual live originating-meeting follow-up obligations/tasks: overdue_count and unowned_overdue_count, actual local due dates; all underlying categories allowed.
rules.selector: At least two eligible distinct plants have observed overdue_count > 0. A separate unowned subclaim requires at least two distinct plants with unowned_overdue_count > 0. Completion/contact/waiver are distinct.
rules.next_step: Offer help reviewing existing task ownership and overdue obligations; do not blame a person or claim unsuccessful contact from task status.
rules.template: {support_count} plants have {sum_overdue_obligations} recorded overdue follow-up obligations in the available shared evidence.

rules.name: Genuine-acquisition momentum support
rules.input: Known valid first-adult-acquisition clock from historical genuine acquisitions, independently of current headcount; uncertainty/provenance carried.
rules.selector: Generate stalled theme only with at least two eligible distinct plants whose confirmed clock >=28 days. Generate slowed theme only with at least two whose confirmed clock is >=21 and <28 days. Do not double count stalled plants in slowed theme. Unresolved possible newer acquisition prevents old-date negative claim.
rules.next_step: Offer an operational growth conversation using the recorded timing; do not call a church unhealthy, forecast acquisition, infer conversions or erase genuine acquisitions after withdrawal.
rules.template: {support_count} plants show {momentum_label} in their available first-adult-acquisition evidence as of {as_of}.

rules.name: Required-training coordination
rules.input: Saved current required person/program assignments and earned/revoked/corrected completion aggregates, required_applicability_known and nonempty obligation_count.
rules.selector: At least two eligible distinct plants with complete applicability evidence and outstanding_required_count > 0 support the pattern. Current roster is explicit, not recalculated from membership. Missing/empty applicability is Unknown, never 100%.
numeric_claims: sum_current_complete_required_obligations / sum_applicable_required_obligations only for identical reported observed cohort with denominator > 0
rules.next_step: Offer coordination around existing assigned programs; no automatic assignment, completion, role qualification or phase effect.
rules.template: {support_count} plants have {sum_outstanding_required_obligations} outstanding saved required-training obligations in the available shared evidence.

evidence_contract.numeric_validation: Each number/date/proportion is a deterministic persisted allowed aggregate fact. Counts use exact integers; displayed percentages carry actual numerator/denominator and one-decimal display rounding, never round a readiness obligation away. No unsupported rates/forecasts/caps.
evidence_contract.model_input: Aggregate-only facts/quality/window/rule outputs plus this whole pinned rubric; protected contributor manifest remains server-only.
evidence_contract.named_output: Server attaches current authorized plant name/shared lens state/short actually-shared reason/canonical link; no per-plant metric table. Already shared aggregate number inside a reason may remain; new numeric pattern claim cites organization/group aggregate.
evidence_contract.reference_citation: Exact passage/source/revision/hash and current body entitlement; no protected contributor/raw-assessment drill-down.
evidence_contract.unknown_output: Use Unknown/limited evidence, observed cohort/window and useful evidence next step. Do not diagnose unavailable data.
evidence_contract.singleton_output: Bounded shared lens row allowed; withhold pattern with insufficient_contributors.

output_contract.body_register: Describe observed patterns and offer operational support. No causal attribution to people, health verdict, compulsory program, ranking or autonomous action.
output_contract.order: Stable rubric rule order then group identity/theme key; never rank plants.
output_contract.all_matching_rules: Retain all eligible finding records; compact UI may paginate without dropping eligibility.
output_contract.empty_patterns: If no rule has two contributors, render insufficient supported patterns/available singleton lens rows. It is not a healthy or negative portfolio verdict.

activation.candidate: immutable authored rubric plus matching fixture/semantic review manifest
activation.activation: explicit validated reference-generation activation under existing reference publisher; no customer/user feedback auto-activation
activation.failed_build: prior active version retained; new generation disabled with reference_not_ready
activation.rollback: new activation record pointing to prior validated immutable bytes
activation.feedback: own authenticated currently authorized reader, bound to exact org/run/finding/version; product-learning signal only

cadence_execution: Dirty/reference/time demand and bounded shared job/attempt/publication contract in docs/architecture/assessment.md; no model calls on reads.
